// diagnostic E2408

Jet.FlattenNonStruct

`#Codable(.Flatten)` on `{field}` needs a struct-typed field.

What

`#Codable(.Flatten)` on `{field}` needs a struct-typed field.

Why

Flatten splices another struct's keys into this object, so the field must itself be a `#Codable` struct — not a primitive, list, or map.

Fix

Give `{field}` a `#Codable` struct type, or drop `#Codable(.Flatten)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.FlattenNonStruct: Tests/UI/serde_flatten_not_struct.stderr.
